exact_denominator.input_activity_unit: precompacted active source in one 16-source mask

existing_rtl_assessment.m79: 96-lane fixed8 assembly is reusable, but source/block weight mapping is absent and its separated command protocol is not the frozen II=3 service top
existing_rtl_assessment.m82: best reusable zero-bubble assembler building block; no weight mapper/service top
existing_rtl_assessment.sparse_mac_pe: wrong lane/broadcast/service semantics and no 32-byte three-beat port
existing_rtl_assessment.hatf96_weight_coalescer: three parallel 32-lane banks provide 96-byte logical bandwidth, not serial 32-byte bandwidth
existing_rtl_assessment.m85_m99: PWP record service only; no real fallback or correction weight service

minimum_baseline_spec.address_equation: base_word=(source*8+block)*24; logical_word=base_word+beat*8; rotate eight 32-bit banks exactly as M85
minimum_baseline_spec.protocol: beat sequence 0,1,2; continuation source/block/tag stable; fail closed; zero-bubble next start at II=3 when output_ready

must_include: M102 fixed8 3-beat weight service for all corrections
one aggregate 256-bit service slot per cycle

throughput_formula.common_clock: frequency cancels and only the matched cycle ratio remains
throughput_formula.reason_forbidden: M85 and M99 are same-function PWP implementations; neither M85 is bit-sparse nor M99 a complete combined candidate service top

findings.finding: No standalone RTL implements the exact precompacted 96-lane, 32-byte-per-cycle, three-beat bit-sparse weight service used by M78/M88.
findings.impact: bit_sparse_cycles has no matched Fmax, area, power, or executable RTL denominator.

findings.finding: M101 measures M85/M99 PWP logic only, while M88 candidate cycles include correction/fallback weight service and other preparation components.
findings.impact: M99-alone Fmax cannot normalize M88 candidate cycles and f_M99/f_M85 cannot multiply the M88 cycle ratio.

findings.finding: bit_sparse_cycles starts after mask popcount/active-source enumeration; no scanner or compactor cycles/area are charged.
findings.required_action: Freeze precompacted-source input scope or include a matched enumerator in both tops.

findings.finding: There is no executable shared-port top that serializes PWP and correction/fallback weight vectors according to the frozen candidate ledger.
findings.required_action: Build and replay m102_combined_candidate_service_top before cycles/Fmax.

findings.finding: Baseline modeled storage is 24576 bytes while candidate listed local storage is 116525 bytes and is itself incomplete.
findings.required_action: Bill macro/decoder/ECC/port costs and add an equal-area baseline before any equal-area claim.

findings.finding: DMA, parser, row writer, double-buffer controller, matcher and packer are not one physically timed candidate/baseline pair.
findings.required_action: Use service-only cycles for a service-island claim, or implement/close complete tops before bounded-module cycles/Fmax.

findings.finding: Service-only and startup/tail/fill-inclusive ratios are 1.409420484x and 1.409375695x respectively.
findings.suggested_action: Freeze one numerator/denominator scope per table and label it.

findings.finding: One catalog escape entry causes 362 heldout uses, while current M99 emits only a zero escape token.
findings.suggested_action: Add exact fallback stress and counters in the combined candidate top.

findings.finding: The frozen workload remains valid825-internal and supplies no sequence-disjoint accuracy or full-network composition.
findings.suggested_action: Keep any future physical result at module/service scope until algorithm/system evidence is separate.
